title: SOLIDWORKS feature and subfeature planning inventory

scope.purpose: A coordinated planning taxonomy joined to extracted installed API declarations.
scope.completeness: All explicitly listed taxonomy rows are planned. No claim of every licensed command, legal option combination, product, file version or native field.
scope.api_anchor_policy: Empty anchors mean an authoritative per-feature API mapping is not established. Observed name matches are discovery leads only.
scope.option_policy: Research axes only; values, defaults, units, dependencies and legal combinations require independent evidence.
scope.campaign_policy: Existing bounded alpha evidence remains campaign-owned; this inventory never promotes or resets it.
scope.status_policy: All authoring, decoding, writing and verification statuses remain unverified.
scope.version_boundary: Official help taxonomy is 2026; observed installed API is 33.0.0.5050. Newer taxonomy entries may be absent or unavailable in the installed snapshot.
